A Tesla saves its owner from prison!

quoted_tweet.author: DogeDesigner
quoted_tweet.text:
Tesla helped save a man from jail.

Kevin Finley was arrested at gunpoint for allegedly fleeing police. His Tesla captured the key moments, showing why he never saw the unmarked police car.

Nearly two years later, the judge watched the video and found him not guilty.
